title: 2024 Topps Allen & Ginter Buzzin' #BUZ-10 - Mason Bee
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2024 Topps Allen & Ginter Buzzin' #BUZ-10 trading card features a unique design focused on the Mason Bee, a player or athlete in the Major League (MLB) baseball world. Manufactured by Topps, this standard-sized card is part of the 2024 Allen & Ginter set and is classified as an insert with no autograph. The card offers collectors a variety of card numbers within the BUZ series, making it a sought-after addition to any sports trading card collection.
